signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.roleTalentHint: Create a profile that clients can find
signUp.roleClientHint: Hire a tutor, a freelancer or a team member
signUp.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>
signUp.acceptRequired: Please accept the terms to continue.

verify.sentBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email address. Open it to verify your account.
verify.resent: Email sent. Check your inbox and the spam folder.
verify.resendWait: You can send it again in {seconds} s.
verify.successBody: Thank you, your address is confirmed.
verify.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
verify.bannerText: Verify your email to contact talents and send reports. We sent you a link.
verify.goLive: Verify your email to go live. Your profile is published, but nobody can see it until you confirm your address.

reset.requestBody: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
reset.sent: If an account exists for this address, we sent a link. It works for one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was already used.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: An account with this email exists but it is not verified. Sign in with your password, verify the email, then try Google again.
errors.OAUTH_FAILED: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.

googleSignUp.title: One more step
googleSignUp.intro: We do not have an account for this Google address yet. Choose how you will use SkillBoard Korea to create it.
googleSignUp.expired: This step has expired. Start again from the sign-in page.
googleSignUp.exists: An account for this address already exists. Sign in instead.

googleLink.title: Link Google?
googleLink.intro: An account with this email already exists. After linking, you can sign in to it with Google.
googleLink.warning: Your password will be removed and other sessions signed out. You can set a new password later in your account settings.
googleLink.expired: This step has expired. Start again from the sign-in page.
googleLink.alreadyLinked: This Google account is already linked. Sign in with Google.
